title: One Hamming plane group and tagged decoding in 228 primitives

claims.statement: For the explicit product of 64 length-seven Hamming components, forty-six nonlinear length-32 dimension-16 tagged components, and one eight-bit tail in proof.md, with the stated plane and direct-address decoder including its exceptional address behavior, average block error is at most 124999999981696481628491/125000000000000000000000 for a uniform 1000-bit message on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses.
For the same explicit code and decoder, the fixed bsc-ops-v1 primitive schedule uses exactly W=228 operations for every received word, with W <= 2^(7833/1000).

experiments.purpose: Verify exact component success and excluded direct-address mass, the full rational error bound, and the fixed primitive count and output with the unmodified reference counter.
